# Loose ends

Things I keep meaning to write down properly, with no tags yet.

The receivers still bother me. A passive ping that never stores a face is a
good rule, but the calibration log will say where the monorail crowds were
each evening, and that is a location archive by another name. Counsel should
see the aggregate error metrics before the pilot route grows.

The dawn team is tired. Relief rosters keep slipping to the last hour, and a
named relief before any extended shift has to become the rule rather than a
favor.

Ask whether the clinic's consent language could be read aloud at intake,
for patients who cannot read the form.
